campaign_posts.title: Bringing EMIRA IV Home
campaign_posts.excerpt: When EMIRA IV left France for Canada in April, I had mixed feelings. On the one hand, I was incredibly excited. Bringing a foiling IMOCA for training in Canada is something that hasn’t been done before, and seeing the boat finally make her way across the Atlantic felt like a major milestone for the campaign. On the other hand, it was bittersweet. …

campaign_posts.title: 2025: A Year of Momentum for Canada Ocean Racing – from Scott
campaign_posts.excerpt: From the outside, it may look like we ’ve been accelerating for a while, but the truth is, this is the first full year the campaign has been under our own control. And what a year it has been. It’s been intense – we’ve rebuilt the team, acquired a new boat, set up a base in Lorient, France, and entered the Rolex Fastnet Race and The Ocean Race Europe. …

position.text: With Emira IV now leaving Canada and heading back to Europe, Scott looks back on a summer spent getting to know the boat, testing its limits and, in the process, learning more about his own.
